meaning: A complete per-source-node semantic coverage inventory paired with independently expected native behavior observations. A tested adapter never removes untested source kinds from the denominator.
coverage: Start from the registered complete verification graph and project plan. Retain every qualified source node exactly once. Calculation v1/v2 nodes receive differential cases from their checked source contracts; other nodes remain explicitly not_evaluable. Unsupported adapters or bounded-run capacity remain unmet, never silently skipped. The aggregate selected-generator check passes only if every node has executed passing controls.
oracle: Interpret checked Calculation source expressions independently of the source renderer: exact UInt64 bigint arithmetic, left-then-right intermediate bounds, declared floor/ceil/reject division and exact failure class/message. Derive deterministic boundary, distinct-parameter, representation and malformed-input cases. Validate all declared inputs including unused ones. Tests include explicit hand-calculated expectations and compiling semantic mutants. Finite cases are bounded test evidence, not a universal equivalence proof.
native: Compile only the checked Calculation module/import closure into a private run subtree with the pinned compiler, after full native compilation and independent surface observation. Execute those pure functions in a separate Node 26.8.1 process with permission enforcement: read only the emitted subtree and fixed runner/case files, no filesystem write, network, child process, worker, addon, FFI or WASI grants. Supply a minimal environment, not inherited credentials. Do not run generated Operations, Workflows, compositions, entry servers or production providers.
custody: Bind the case plan to the complete verification input and exact source contracts/modules. Check all native source bytes before emitting semantic modules. Track exact emitted inventory, runner, case and compiler configuration bytes; recheck before and after execution and during final workspace currentness. Late source/tool/native/semantic-workspace drift invalidates dependent semantic evidence. Missing, duplicate, reordered, altered or surplus observations cannot pass.
result: Compare every actual bigint result or exact typed failure against the independent expected outcome, including no getter/coercion calls or input mutation. Preserve observations/expected digests and per-node coverage. Any mismatch fails; partial tested coverage remains not_evaluable with executed evidence and explicit remaining nodes. Keep cross-generator, composition behavior and separate safe-output requirements unchanged.

bounds.subprocess: existing bounded timeout/output limits; resource exhaustion is not passing evidence

compatibility: Preserve legacy defaults, all 42 earlier source pins, generated arithmetic forms, source field order, rounding choices, numeric profile and canonical relationships. Add only this definition to the capsule. This supersedes the earlier no-domain-execution posture only for these explicitly bounded pure Calculation controls; no authority, publication, provider or default-cutover effect.
validation: Exact values, boundaries, all rounding modes, intermediate error order, malformed representations and unused inputs
Qualified same-name distinct calculations do not collapse
Full source-node denominator and unsupported kinds remain explicit
Actual native execution and compiling mutants, forged observation rejection
Permission-denied write/network/child access and minimal environment
Final drift, complete cleanup and source/snapshot/CLI regressions
